tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) to start up, tremble, shake, spring up
1a) (Qal) to start up
1b) (Piel) to leap
1c) (Hiphil) to cause to start up

1) to loose, let loose, undo, be free, be loose
1a) (Hiphil)
1a1) to unfasten, loosen
1a2) to set free, unbind
Aramaic equivalent: ne.tar (נְתַר "to strip" H5426)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to jump, i.e. be violently agitated; causatively, to terrify, shake off, untie
strongs_1890.kjv_def: drive asunder, leap, (let) loose, [idiom] make, move, undo.
